description.value: Coal City Cycles is a full-service bike shop in Nanaimo, BC, stocking brands such as Ibis, Marin, Scott, Pivot Cycles, and CUBE across mountain, gravel, road, e-bike, and BMX disciplines. The shop employs professionally trained technicians who handle everything from minor adjustments to full overhauls, and offers lifetime complimentary tune-ups on bikes purchased in-store. For touring cyclists moving through Vancouver Island, it represents a well-equipped stop for parts, accessories, and mechanical expertise.

The site shows a broad parts and accessories inventory but contains no explicit mention of floor pumps for visiting cyclists, same-day urgency guarantees, touring-specific parts, rentals, or most other optional amenities. The OSM website URL matches the live site; the phone number does not appear in the extracted website text, so phone confirmation is null.
